title: Script Controller
description: Attaches one or more visual scripts to an entity and exposes local script variables in the inspector. Use Script Controller to run gameplay logic and tune values per entity.

blocks.content: The **Script Controller** component binds [visual scripting](visual_scripting/graph_concepts) graphs from the **Scripts** panel to an [entity](components/entities_and_prefabs). A single **Script Controller** can run multiple scripts on the same entity, and any local [variables](visual_scripting/variables_and_collections) defined in those scripts appear directly in the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector) so you can customize values per entity instance.

items.title: Multi-Script Stack
items.desc: Attach multiple modular scripts (such as movement, combat, and health) to one entity.

items.title: Exposed Variables
items.desc: Tune local script variables like speed or jump force directly in the inspector.

items.title: Instance Overrides
items.desc: Override variable values on individual entities and reset to defaults with one click.

items.title: Quick Graph Launch
items.desc: Click **Open Visual Script** to jump straight into the node graph tab.

items: Select an entity in the [Scene Hierarchy](interface/scene_hierarchy) or [Scene Viewport](interface/scene_viewport).
In the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector), click **Add Component...** under **Actions** and select **Script Controller**.
In the bottom bar, click **Scripts** to open the **Scripts** panel (or click the 3-dots button next to **Attached Scripts** and select **Add Script...**).
Right-click a script in the **Scripts** panel and select **Add to [Entity ID]**.

blocks.content: Select an attached script from the **Attached Scripts** dropdown in the **Script Controller** section to manage its state and variables.

rows: Dropdown listing all visual scripts attached to this entity. Active scripts show a checkmark.
Menu next to the dropdown with **Add Script...** (opens the **Scripts** dock) and **Remove Current** (detaches the selected script).
Toggles **Active** or **Inactive** to enable or pause execution of the selected script on this entity.
Opens the selected script's node graph in a workspace tab.
Lists every local variable (number, boolean, or string) defined in the script. Edited values highlight in amber and display a reset button.

blocks.message: Click the amber reset icon next to an overridden script variable to restore its default value from the script's Variable Manager.

blocks.content: Reuse one patrol script across multiple enemies while giving each enemy its own movement speed.

items: Open your enemy script in the graph editor and create a local **Number** variable named **MoveSpeed** with a default value of **150**.
Attach the script to two enemy entities in your scene via **Script Controller**.
Select the second enemy in the [Scene Hierarchy](interface/scene_hierarchy).
In the **Script Controller** section of the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector), change **MoveSpeed** to **300**. The input highlights in amber, and only that enemy moves faster.

blocks.content: Scripts attached to a **Script Controller** start execution from [Scene & Lifecycle](node_library/game_lifecycle), input, or signal event nodes and read or update variables from [Audio & System](node_library/system_utilities).

rows: Fires once when the scene finishes loading.
Fires every frame while the entity and script are active.
Reads the value of a local variable (including per-entity inspector overrides) or a global variable.
Updates a local or global variable at runtime.
Broadcasts a named event to other scripts in the scene.
Runs logic when a matching signal is broadcast.
**Add to [Entity]** does not appear when right-clicking a script
Select the target entity in the **Scene Hierarchy** first and make sure it has a **Script Controller** component attached.
A variable from my script does not appear in **Script Controller**

Only **Local** variables (Number, Boolean, and String) appear on the entity inspector. **Global** variables are shared across the whole project and are managed in [Variables & Collections](visual_scripting/variables_and_collections).
Attached script does not run during preview
Check that both the entity's **Active** button in **Object** and the script's **Active Status** in **Script Controller** are set to **Active**.
